canonical_name: Phragmen-Lindelof maximum-principle family for angular complex domains
literal_source_claim_en: The Phragmen-Lindelof principle in an angular region.
source_attribution: Ernst Lindelof, 1908 (catalog metadata only; inspected identifiable paper is joint with E. Phragmen)
statement_blocker: The catalog does not select the 1908 paper's general principle, Part II no. 4 sector proposition, Part II no. 5 connected-domain theorem, or a modern variant. It omits the sector geometry, function codomain and regularity, boundary condition, angle-sensitive growth restriction, conclusion, and boundary cases. Pinned mathlib provides strip, coordinate-quadrant, and right-half-plane theorems but no exposed arbitrary-angle theorem. Selecting one declaration or inventing a transport at intake would substitute or broaden the target.

degenerate_case_status: No case is excluded before a proposition is selected; the statement phase must resolve every geometry, function, growth, boundary, and conclusion case listed in scope-map.md.
